name: 05-timeline-390
panelText:
WHAT THE JOURNEY AHEAD LOOKS LIKE.

YOUR TIMELINE DEPENDS ON APPROVALS, CONTENT READINESS AND CONNECTED SYSTEMS. THIS IS THE WORKING RANGE AND THE PHASES AHEAD.

STANDARD
YOUR CHOICE
6 – 14 MONTHS
PRODUCTION AT THE NORMAL PACE, WITH WORK IN PARALLEL WHEREVER THE PLAN ALLOWS.
$38,000 – $76,000
EXPEDITED
6 – 12 MONTHS
A FASTER PATH: ABOUT 20% SOONER.
$70,000 – $141,000
WHY EXPEDITED IS NOT TWICE AS FAST
PHASES
01
BLUEPRINT & ALIGNMENT
WE CONFIRM SCOPE, PRIORITIES AND STRUCTURAL DIRECTION.
02
IDENTITY & DIRECTION
CORE VISUAL AND VERBAL CHOICES ARE SETTLED.
03
BUILD & INTEGRATION
PAGES, FEATURES AND CONNECTED SYSTEMS ARE DEVELOPED.
04
REVIEW & REFINEMENT
WE REVIEW, ADJUST AND TIGHTEN THE EXPERIENCE.
05
LAUNCH PREPARATION
FINAL CHECKS, OUTSIDE-SYSTEM READINESS AND HANDOFF.
WHAT AFFECTS TIMING
APPROVALS
2 REVIEW ROUNDS, EACH PLANNED AT 2 BUSINESS DAYS. A LATER REPLY MOVES THE WINDOW.
CONTENT DELIVERY
THE WINDOW COUNTS FROM WHEN YOUR COPY AND IMAGES ARRIVE.
CONNECTED TOOLS
LAUNCH WAITS ON THE OUTSIDE SYSTEMS YOU CONNECT.
SCOPE CHANGES
CHANGES AFTER BLUEPRINT REVIEW PRODUCE A NEW ESTIMATE.
WHAT HAS TO HAPPEN IN ORDER
AFTER YOU SUBMIT

YOUR WINDOW ASSUMES EACH REVIEW COMES BACK WITHIN 2 BUSINESS DAYS. WHEN A REVIEW OR CONTENT ARRIVES LATER, THE WINDOW MOVES BY THE SAME AMOUNT. THIS IS A PROJECTED ESTIMATE. IT IS NOT A QUOTE AND NOT A SCHEDULE. ESTIMATE REFERENCE V1.0.0
